arxiv-1602-09023.title: Testing Elementary Cycles Formulation of Quantum Mechanics in Carbon Nanotubes and Superconductivity
arxiv-1602-09023.creator: Donatello Dolce & Andrea Perali
arxiv-1602-09023.description: Abstract Elementary Cycles are intrinsic periodic phenomena, classical in the essence, whose classical relativistic dynamics reproduce the complete coherence (perfect recurrences) typically associated to the pure quantum behaviours of elementary particles. They can be regarded as effective representations of ’t Hooft Cellular Automata.

arxiv-2110-09129.title: Deep Models with Fusion Strategies for MVP Point Cloud Registration
arxiv-2110-09129.creator: Lifa Zhu, Changwei Lin, Dongrui Liu, Xin Li, Francisco Gómez-Fernández
arxiv-2110-09129.description: Abstract 1 Introduction The main goal of point cloud registration in Multi-View Partial (MVP) Challenge 2021 1 1 1 https://competitions.codalab.org/competitions/33430 pan2021variational is to estimate a rigid transformation to align a point cloud pair. The pairs in this competition have the characteristics of low overlap, non-uniform density, unrestricted rotations and ambiguity, which pose a huge challenge to the registration task.

Following perturbations or due to ambient noise, the system is pushed away from its initial equilibrium and, depending on the direction and the amplitude of the excursion, might undergo a transition to another equilibrium. arxiv-2210-05805.title: Exploration via Elliptical Episodic Bonuses
arxiv-2210-05805.creator: Mikael Henaff, Roberta Raileanu, aaaaa Minqi Jiang, Tim Rocktäschel
arxiv-2210-05805.description: Abstract In recent years, a number of reinforcement learning (RL) methods have been proposed to explore complex environments which differ across episodes. In this work, we show that the effectiveness of these methods critically relies on a count-based episodic term in their exploration bonus.

arxiv-2410-12087.title: Equivariant Weiss Calculus

arxiv-2410-12087.description: Abstract . In this paper, we introduce an equivariant analog of Weiss calculus of functors for all finite group G \mathrm{G} . In our theory, Taylor approximations and derivatives are index by finite dimensional G \mathrm{G} -representations, and homogeneous layers are classified by orthogonal G \mathrm{G} -spectra.

arxiv-2410-16902.title: Mass spectra of doubly charmed tetraquarks T c ​ c T_{cc}
arxiv-2410-16902.creator: You-You Lin, Ji-Ying Wang, Ailin Zhang
arxiv-2410-16902.description: Abstract Motivated by the first observation of a doubly charmed tetraquark candidate T c ​ c ​ ( 3875 ) + T_{cc}(3875)^{+} , we perform a systematic calculation of the masses of some constituent diquarks and the doubly charmed tetraquark states from 1 ​ S 1S to 2 ​ P 2P excitations in a nonrelativistic constituent quark potential model.

arxiv-2411-01279.title: Proton induced reaction on 108 Cd for astrophysical p-process studies Journal: J. Phys. G: Nucl. Phys.
arxiv-2411-01279.creator: Sukhendu Saha, Dipali Basak, Tanmoy Bar, Lalit Kumar Sahoo, Jagannath Datta, Sandipan Dasgupta, Norikazu Kinoshita, Chinmay Basu
arxiv-2411-01279.description: Abstract The proton capture cross-section of the least abundant proton-rich stable isotope of cadmium, 108 Cd (abundance 0.89%), has been measured near the Gamow window corresponding to a temperature range of 3-4 GK. The measurement of the 108 Cd(p, γ \gamma ) 109 In reaction was carried out using the activation technique.

arxiv-2506-21658.title: Synergies between Euclid , Roman and JWST Could Reveal Quasars at up to z ∼ z\sim 15
arxiv-2506-21658.creator: Muhammad A. Latif, Daniel J. Whalen
arxiv-2506-21658.description: Abstract Although supermassive black holes (SMBHs) are found at the centers of most galaxies today, over 300 have now been discovered at z > z> 6, including a 4 × 10 7 4\times 10^{7} M ⊙ M_{\odot} BH in UHZ1 at z = 10.1 z=10.

arxiv-2602-17854.title: On the Evaluation Protocol of “Gesture Recognition for UAV-based Rescue Operation based on Deep Learning”: A Subject-Independence Perspective
arxiv-2602-17854.creator: Domonkos Varga
arxiv-2602-17854.description: Abstract This paper presents a methodological analysis of the gesture-recognition approach proposed by Liu and Szirányi, with a particular focus on the validity of their evaluation protocol. We show that the reported near-perfect accuracy metrics result from a frame-level random train–test split that inevitably mixes samples from the same subjects across both sets, causing severe data leakage.

pmc-11470221.title: Evolutionary Trends in the Adoption, Adaptation, and Abandonment of Mobile Health Technologies: Viewpoint Based on 25 Years of Research
pmc-11470221.creator: Jennifer Portz, Susan Moore, Sheana Bull, Gunther Eysenbach, Sarah Iribarren, Michael Stach
pmc-11470221.description: Over the past quarter-century, mobile health (mHealth) technologies have experienced significant changes in adoption rates, adaptation strategies, and instances of abandonment. Understanding the underlying factors driving these trends is essential for optimizing the design, implementation, and sustainability of interventions using these technologies.

pmc-11558659.title: TSTA: thread and SIMD-based trapezoidal pairwise/multiple sequence-alignment method
pmc-11558659.creator: Peiyu Zong, Wenpeng Deng, Jian Liu, Jue Ruan, zong peiyu, Scott Edmunds, Hongfang Zhang, Christopher Hunter, Xingbao Song, Yuansheng Liu, Hongfang Zhang, zong peiyu, Hongfang Zhang, Yuansheng Liu, Hongfang Zhang, zong peiyu, Hongfang Zhang, Yuansheng Liu, Hongfang Zhang, zong peiyu, Hongfang Zhang,
pmc-11558659.description: The rapid advancements in sequencing length necessitate the adoption of increasingly efficient sequence alignment algorithms. The Needleman–Wunsch method introduces the foundational dynamic-programming matrix calculation for global alignment, which evaluates the overall alignment of sequences. However, this method is known to be highly time-consuming. The proposed TSTA algorithm leverages both vector-level and thread-level parallelism to accelerate pairwise and multiple sequence alignments.

pmc-12618886.title: Rosemary essential oil: chemical composition, antiviral, cytotoxicity, and in silico molecular docking analysis against tobacco mosaic virus
pmc-12618886.creator: Abdulaziz A Al-Askar, Karrar A Hamzah, Dalia G Aseel, Ali H El-Far, Mohamed M Abdelhamid, Said Behiry, Toufic Elbeaino, Ahmed Abdelkhalek
pmc-12618886.description: Aromatic plants represent a significant source of bioactive compounds and have recently expanded their potential applications in agriculture. In the current study, the essential oil of Salvia rosmarinus (rosemary) was extracted, and its chemical composition was analyzed using gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS).

pmc-12916074.title: Asian Immigrant Parents' Language Use and Perceptions of Parent–Child Relationship Quality
pmc-12916074.creator: Cindy J. Huang, Kailee Kodama Muscente, Nolan Zane, Yuuko Uchikoshi, Cindy Y. Huang
pmc-12916074.description: Research on Asian immigrant families has primarily focused on the influence of cultural factors, such as acculturation, on parent–child relationships, yet emerging research suggests that language use may play a critical role, especially when multiple languages (e.g., English and/or a heritage language; HL) may be used in the parent–child communication context.

pmc-13265696.title: Dermal fibroblasts attenuate osteoarthritis by restoring synovial fibroblast homeostasis
pmc-13265696.creator: Lei Shi, Tong Xing, Kexin Liu, Kewei Rong, Hongsheng Li, Yin Li, Lizhi Jiang, Tingxian Guo, Chen Chen, Tobias Winkler, An Qin, Jie Zhao
pmc-13265696.description: BackgroundManaging early-to-mid-stage knee osteoarthritis (OA) remains an unmet clinical need. Synovitis driven by disrupted synovial fibroblast lineage homeostasis is a central pathological driver, but current anti-inflammatory treatments fail to correct this underlying dysfunction.MethodsFibroblast lineage alterations and phenotypic similarities between dermal fibroblasts (DFbs) and synovial fibroblasts were characterized via synovial single-cell sequencing, histology and transcriptomics.

pmc-13279860.title: From Sparse Nanoparticles to Graded Interfaces: Beyond Classical Descriptions of LiF Growth on Organic Semiconductors
pmc-13279860.creator: Pedro Oliviera, Felix Maye, Ayse Turak
pmc-13279860.description: Small‐molecule π‐conjugated semiconductors provide an ordered platform for probing interfacial mechanisms in organic optoelectronics, where device performance and stability are dominated by interface effects. Lithium fluoride, despite its widespread use as an interlayer, remains paradoxical: essential for high device efficiencies yet governed by poorly understood growth processes that undermine reproducibility.

pmc-13462996.title: Cross-seasonal influence of China Coastal Current water on spring carbonate system in the northern South China Sea
pmc-13462996.creator: Shiping Lei, Yi Yang, Dezhi Bu, Xianghui Guo, Yan Li, Kuanbo Zhou, Jin-Yu Terence Yang, Zhongyong Gao
pmc-13462996.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study investigates the carbonate system in the northern South China Sea shelf off the Pearl River estuary during the spring of 2023. Contrary to the typical distribution pattern observed in river-dominated coast where dissolved inorganic carbon (DIC) increases offshore, field observations revealed higher DIC in inshore waters (> 1980 µmol kg− 1) than in offshore seawaters (< 1970 µmol kg− 1), with DIC in the coastal zone being 20.9±8.8 µmol kg− 1 higher than that offshore.
